title: fix(app-shell): the inbox bell names its unread count, and the console sidebar is a navigation landmark
body:
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xSXoaF6hSeT7sjxcA7Ccxox)_ Fixes #32159 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**:控制台右上角通知铃铛的无障碍名称从固定的 "Open inbox" 改为带数量的 "Notifications, 3 unread topics"(有待审批时再加 ", 1 pending approval");侧边栏导航包进一个 `nav` 地标 "App navigation"。界面外观不变。 - **为什么改**:读屏用户以前听不到铃铛上的未读数,也无法按地标跳到侧边栏。卡片另外两条(分组折叠按钮、手机侧栏按钮无名称)在 `main` 上实测已满足,只加保护性测试,未改代码(席位更正记录 6775284999)。 - **风险与回滚**:低。只动 `InboxPopover.tsx` 的 `aria-label` 与 `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 的一个 `div`→`nav`;不新增翻译键(`en` 包 0 字节)。按名字 "Open inbox" 找铃铛的外部脚本需改用 "Notifications"。回滚即 revert。 - **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx`(`ariaLabel` 的拼法)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`(`nav` 包裹位置)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocalizedSidebarTrigger.appBar-12429.test.tsx`(新地标与手机抽屉 pin)。 - **两分钟验证**:打开控制台任一应用页,用浏览器无障碍面板看铃铛,名称应为 "Notifications, N unread topics…";侧栏应是一个名为 "App navigation" 的 navigation 地标。 - **需要你做的**:无,席位评审后落地。 ## What changes - **Inbox bell (`InboxPopover`).** The accessible name was `sidebar.inboxAriaLabel` ("Open inbox") whatever the badge said. The badge is content inside a button that has an `aria-label`, so the count was never part of the announced name. The name is now `sidebar.notifications` ("Notifications") followed by each non-zero addend of the badge, in the plural forms the popover's own breakdown line already uses (`notifications.badgeNotifications` / `notifications.badgeApprovals`, `_one` / `_other`): "Notifications, 3 unread topics", "Notifications, 1 unread topic", "Notifications, 3 unread topics, 1 pending approval"; "Notifications" alone with nothing waiting. The header bell and the `global:notifications` page block draw this same control, so both change. The visible badge and the "Inbox" tooltip are unchanged. - **Sidebar landmark (`UnifiedSidebar`).** The `div` wrapping the sidebar's content slot is now `nav aria-label="App navigation"` (`console.nav.menuLabel`, the label the `nav-menu` page block already uses). The `Sidebar` primitive is Shadcn-synced and draws a plain `div` on desktop and a dialog on a phone, so the landmark rides inside its content slot and reaches the drawer too. One landmark per open view: the desktop sidebar, or the phone drawer once it opens (the closed drawer is not drawn). Nothing nests it. - **No new strings.** `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` is untouched: +0 bytes. Every key used is already in every pack. - **Already met on `main` (no code change, pinned):** the nav-group disclosures are named by their group label and carry `aria-expanded` (`ui/packages/layout` untouched), and the sidebar trigger is "Toggle sidebar" with `aria-expanded` at every width. Premise correction recorded on the card as comment 6775284999. ## Tests All role-based (`getByRole('button', { name })`, `getByRole('navigation')`), driven through real clicks where state changes. - `InboxPopover.badgePlural-13133.test.tsx` (real i18next + shipped `en` pack), new `describe`: the bell's name with a count of 3 ("…, 3 unread topics"), of 1 ("…, 1 unread topic"), with approvals beside topics, and PRESERVATION with nothing waiting ("Notifications"). - `LocalizedSidebarTrigger.appBar-12429.test.tsx` (real `UnifiedSidebar` + real trigger), new `describe`: desktop has exactly one `navigation` named "App navigation" holding the entries and no nested `nav`; at 375 px the trigger `{ name: 'Toggle sidebar', expanded: false }` is clicked, the drawer then holds exactly one landmark, and the trigger reports `expanded: true`. - `UnifiedSidebar.groupDefaultOpen-13336.test.tsx`, new `describe`: a collapsed group is `{ name: 'Advanced', expanded: false }` (its count badge stays out of the name); clicking flips `expanded` under the same name; both disclosures sit inside the landmark. - Three existing files found the bell by the old name and now find it by `/^Notifications(,|$)/`: `InboxPopover.openingTab-11698`, `InboxPopover.phoneWidth-29076`, `global-page-blocks.render` (two sites). No assertion was removed.
Ablations (each mutation landed on disk via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, run, then restored; git diff HEAD empty after each) | Mutation | Result | |:--|:--| | bell: drop the unread-topics addend (`...(unreadTopics > 0` → `...(false`) | 3 count pins fail; the 3 breakdown pins and the zero-count preservation pin stay green | | landmark: `nav` → `nav role="presentation"` | 3 landmark pins fail (desktop, phone drawer, group-in-landmark); 10 pass | | group name: trigger text `{groupLabel}` → `{null}` (`ui/packages/layout`, never committed) | all 6 tests in the group file fail, the 3 new ones included | | group state: `aria-expanded={undefined}` on the trigger (never committed) | all 6 fail | | toggle name: `const label = ''` in `LocalizedSidebarTrigger` | 5 of 7 fail, the new phone landmark pin included |
## Acceptance notes - The bell names the badge's two addends separately rather than "3 unread": the badge sums unread topics and pending approvals, and approvals are not "unread". The parts are joined with ", ", fixed in code, so no new key reaches the eager `en` pack. - The phone drawer's header (app name and "All apps") sits above the content slot, outside the landmark. It names the app and leads out of it; the landmark holds the app's navigation entries. ## Verification Measured in Chromium (Playwright `ariaSnapshot` + `getByRole`) against showcase `objectstack dev --fresh` and the console served by Vite from this tree's `ui/` source. | Reading | `main` `60b99f8f` | this branch | |:--|:--|:--| | bell | `button "Open inbox": "4"` | `button "Notifications, 1 unread topic, 3 pending approvals": "4"` | | `getByRole('navigation')`, desktop task list | 0 | 1, `navigation "App navigation"` | | phone 390 px, drawer open | 0 | 1; `nav nav` = 0; closed drawer 0 | | group disclosures | `button "Workspace" [expanded]`, … | unchanged | | sidebar trigger | `button "Toggle sidebar" [expanded]` | unchanged | | buttons with an empty name (task list, app landing, drawer) | 0 | 0 |
Local gates on head 48dc405d (full record: seat project files card-32159/gates-48dc405d.txt) - `dispatch-gates --commands` derived list: 36 of 36 exit 0 (34 on the first merge head `24389682`, plus `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` there). The second merge of `origin/main` touched none of this PR's files; the 6 touched test files were re-run on `48dc405d`: 43 / 43 pass. - Not derived, ordered: `check-sdui-manifest` 0, `ui check:spec-symbols` 0, `ui check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations). - `@object-ui/app-shell type-check` 0. - App-shell tests NARROWED: 284 files (all of `layout/__tests__` plus every `ui` test importing `InboxPopover`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `AppHeader`, `ConsoleLayout`, the `global:notifications` renderer or `useInboxBell`), 2,594 tests pass. The full 2,227-file suite did not finish in 60 min on this container; CI Test UI runs it. - NOT MEASURED locally: `ui check:eager-closure` (no console build). This diff changes no locale pack: `en.ts` +0 bytes.
